/*
  Document      : financial_balance_sheet.js
  Description   : Balance Sheet (Neraca Keuangan) - Read-only report
<<<<<<< Updated upstream
  Backend       : /rab-project/dev/php-crud/balancesheetCRD.php
=======
  Backend       : /rab-project/live/php-crud/balancesheetCRD.php
>>>>>>> Stashed changes

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Balance <em>Sheet</em>";

    ['addData', 'editData', 'deleteData'].forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // 0. Container filter & report
    var gridContainer = document.getElementById('divMainGrid');
    var filterBarDiv = document.createElement('div');
    filterBarDiv.id = 'bsFilterBar';
    filterBarDiv.style.padding = '0 10px';

    var reportDiv = document.createElement('div');
    reportDiv.id = 'bsReportContainer';
    reportDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:15px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color:#fff; margin:0 10px 10px 10px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); font-size:13px;';

    if (gridContainer && gridContainer.parentNode) {
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(filterBarDiv, gridContainer);
        gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(reportDiv, gridContainer);
    }

    // 1. Store Periode
    var periodField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'period_name' }, { name: 'start_date' }, { name: 'end_date' }];
    var periodDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/balancesheetCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_periods' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, periodField),
        listeners: {
            load: function (store) {
                if (store.getCount() > 0 && !fldPeriod.getValue()) {
                    fldPeriod.setValue(store.getAt(0).get('id'));
                    loadBalanceSheet();
                }
            }
        }
    });
    periodDs.load();

    // 2. Filter Bar
    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', width: 220, store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Tampilkan', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });

    var filterPanel = new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: 'bsFilterBar',
        layout: 'column',
        border: false,
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent; padding:8px 0;',
        defaults: { border: false, bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;' },
        items: [
            { columnWidth: 0.35, layout: 'form', labelWidth: 60, items: fldPeriod },
            { columnWidth: 0.15, style: 'padding-top:2px;', items: btnShow }
        ]
    });

    function loadBalanceSheet() {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/balancesheetCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_balance_sheet', period_id: perId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    reportDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">' + (res.message || 'Gagal memuat data.') + '</div>';
                    return;
                }
                renderBSView(res);
            }
        });
    }

    function renderBSView(res) {
        var fmt = function (val) { return Ext.util.Format.number(val || 0, '0,000.00'); };

        var balanceColor = res.is_balanced ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b';
        var balanceText  = res.is_balanced ? 'BALANCE ✓' : 'TIDAK BALANCE ✗';

        var html = '<h2 style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:4px; font-weight:normal;">NERACA KEUANGAN</h2>' +
                   '<h4 style="text-align:center; color:#bbb; margin-top:0; font-weight:normal;">Per Tanggal: ' + res.as_of_date + ' (' + res.period_name + ')</h4>' +
                   '<div style="text-align:center; margin-bottom:15px;"><b style="color:' + balanceColor + '; font-size:14px;">[ STATUS: ' + balanceText + ' ]</b></div>' +
                   '<hr style="border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); margin:15px 0;" />';

        html += '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse;" color:"#ffeb3b"; font-size:"13px";"cellpadding="6">' +
                '<tr style="vertical-align:top;">' +

                // KOLOM KIRI: ASET
                '<td width="50%" style="border-right:1px solid rgb(138, 0, 0); padding-right:15px;">' +
                    '<h3 style="color:#98db34; margin-bottom:8px;">ASET (AKTIVA)</h3>' +
                    '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse;">';
        
        Ext.each(res.assets, function (a) {
            html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); color:#ffeb3b ;">' +
                    '<td>' + a.account_code + '</td>' +
                    '<td>' + a.account_name + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmt(a.balance) + '</td>' +
                    '</tr>';
        });

        html += '</table>' +
                '<div style="margin-top:20px; padding:10px; background:rgba(234, 0, 255, 0.05);color: #98db34; font-weight:bold; display:flex; justify-content:space-between;">' +
                '<span>TOTAL ASET</span>' +
                '<span style="color:#98db34;">' + fmt(res.total_asset) + '</span>' +
                '</div>' +
                '</td>' +

                // KOLOM KANAN: LIABILITAS & EKUITAS
                '<td width="50%" style="padding-left:15px;">' +
                    '<h3 style="color:#f39c12; margin-bottom:8px;">LIABILITAS (KEWAJIBAN)</h3>' +
                    '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; margin-bottom:15px;color: #f39c12;">';
        
        Ext.each(res.liabilities, function (l) {
            html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">' +
                    '<td>' + l.account_code + '</td>' +
                    '<td>' + l.account_name + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmt(l.balance) + '</td>' +
                    '</tr>';
        });

        html += '<tr style="font-weight:bold; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);">' +
                '<td colspan="2">TOTAL LIABILITAS</td>' +
                '<td align="right">' + fmt(res.total_liability) + '</td>' +
                '</tr></table>' +

                '<h3 style="color:#f39c12; margin-bottom:8px;">EKUITAS (MODAL)</h3>' +
                '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse;color: #f39c12;">';

        Ext.each(res.equities, function (eq) {
            html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);">' +
                    '<td>' + eq.account_code + '</td>' +
                    '<td>' + eq.account_name + '</td>' +
                    '<td align="right">' + fmt(eq.balance) + '</td>' +
                    '</tr>';
        });

        html += '<tr style="font-weight:bold; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);">' +
                '<td colspan="2">TOTAL EKUITAS</td>' +
                '<td align="right">' + fmt(res.total_equity) + '</td>' +
                '</tr></table>' +

                '<div style="margin-top:20px; padding:10px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-weight:bold; display:flex; justify-content:space-between;color: #f39c12;">' +
                '<span>TOTAL LIABILITAS & EKUITAS</span>' +
                '<span style="color:#f39c12;">' + fmt(res.total_liability_equity) + '</span>' +
                '</div>' +

                '</td>' +
                '</tr>' +
                '</table>';

        reportDiv.innerHTML = html;
    }

    btnShow.on('click', loadBalanceSheet);

    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        window.open('../pdf/balancesheet.php?period_id=' + perId, 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };

    if (document.getElementById('popOK')) {
        document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
        };
    }
});

                    level: fldLevel.getValue(),
                    active: fldActive.getValue() ? 'true' : 'false'
                },
                success: function (response) {

                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message);
                    if (res.success) {
                        binDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                        mainDs.load();
                        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    }
                },
                failure: function () {
                    Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                }
            });
        };
    }

    if (document.getElementById('editorWdw')) {
        document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    }

                if (e.field === 'qty') {
                    var maxQty = parseFloat(e.record.get('stock_available')) || 0;
                    var qtyInput = parseFloat(e.value) || 0;

                    }
                    if (qtyInput < 0) {
                        e.record.set('qty', 0);
                    }
                }
                updateTransferTotalLabel();
            }
        }

    function showLogo(type) {
        var img = document.getElementById('logoImg_' + type), none = document.getElementById('logoNone_' + type);
        if (!img) return;
        var has = !!settingsState.company['has_logo_' + (type === 'document' ? 'document' : 'app')];
        if (!has) { img.style.display = 'none'; none.style.display = ''; return; }
        var v = settingsState.company['logo_' + (type === 'document' ? 'document' : 'app') + '_v'] || 0;
        img.onload = function () { img.style.display = ''; none.style.display = 'none'; };
        img.onerror = function () { img.style.display = 'none'; none.style.display = ''; };
        img.src = CRD + '?task=logo&type=' + type + '&v=' + v + '&_=' + new Date().getTime();
    }

    function wireLogo(type) {
        var file = document.getElementById('logoFile_' + type);
        document.getElementById('logoUp_' + type).onclick = function () {
            if (!file.files.length) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih file logo terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
            var f = file.files[0];
            if (['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'].indexOf(f.type) < 0) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Format logo harus PNG, JPEG, atau WEBP.'); return; }
            if (f.size > 1048576) { Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Ukuran logo maksimal 1 MB.'); return; }
            var fd = new FormData();
            fd.append('type', type);
            fd.append('file', f);
            fetch(CRD + '?task=upload_logo', { method: 'POST', body: fd, credentials: 'same-origin' })
                .then(function (r) { return r.text(); })
                .then(function (t) {
                    var res;
                    try { res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(t); } catch (e) { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Respons server tidak valid.'); return; }
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) { file.value = ''; reloadSettings(); }
                })
                .catch(function () { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.'); });
        };
        document.getElementById('logoDel_' + type).onclick = function () {
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Hapus Logo', 'Hapus logo ini?', function (btn) {
                if (btn !== 'yes') return;
                ajax({ task: 'delete_logo', type: type }, function (res) {
                    Ext.Msg.alert(res.success ? 'Sukses' : 'Gagal', res.message || '');
                    if (res.success) reloadSettings();
                });
            });
        };
    }

          icon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="16" rx="2"/><circle cx="9" cy="10" r="1.6"/><path d="M21 16l-5-5-8 8"/></svg>' },
        { title: 'Keuangan & Mata Uang', sub: 'Mata uang dasar & laporan',
          icon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M14.5 9.2c-.4-.8-1.4-1.2-2.5-1.2-1.4 0-2.5.7-2.5 1.8 0 2.6 5 1.2 5 3.8 0 1.1-1.1 1.8-2.5 1.8-1.2 0-2.2-.5-2.6-1.4"/><path d="M12 6v2M12 16v2"/></svg>' },
        { title: 'Dokumen', sub: 'Footer & penandatangan',
          icon: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 2h8l4 4v16H6z"/><path d="M14 2v4h4M9 12h6M9 16h6"/></svg>' }
    ];

    var navDiv = document.createElement('div');
    navDiv.className = 'st-nav';
    navDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="st-bar" id="stBar"></div>' + TAB_DEFS.map(function (t, i) {
        return '<button type="button" class="st-tab" data-i="' + i + '"><span class="st-ico">' + t.icon + '</span>' +
               '<span class="st-txt"><b>' + t.title + '</b><small>' + t.sub + '</small></span></button>';
    }).join('');

    host.appendChild(navDiv);
    host.appendChild(bodyDiv);

    var cardPanel = new Ext.Panel({
        renderTo: bodyDiv,
        border: false,
        layout: 'card',
        activeItem: 0,
        layoutConfig: { deferredRender: false, layoutOnCardChange: true },
        bodyStyle: 'background:transparent;',
        height: Math.max(320, totalH - 78),
        items: [companyForm, logoPanel, financeForm, docForm]
    });

    var currentTab = 0;
    function setTab(i) {
        currentTab = i;
        cardPanel.getLayout().setActiveItem(i);
        var btns = navDiv.querySelectorAll('.st-tab');
        for (var k = 0; k < btns.length; k++) {
            if (k === i) btns[k].classList.add('on'); else btns[k].classList.remove('on');
        }
        var bar = document.getElementById('stBar'), b = btns[i];
        bar.style.width = b.offsetWidth + 'px';
        bar.style.transform = 'translateX(' + b.offsetLeft + 'px)';
        var el = cardPanel.items.itemAt(i).getEl();
        el.removeClass('st-in');
        void el.dom.offsetWidth;                 // restart animasi
        el.addClass('st-in');
    }
    Ext.each(navDiv.querySelectorAll('.st-tab'), function (btn) {
        btn.onclick = function () { setTab(parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-i'), 10)); };
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { setTab(currentTab); });
    setTimeout(function () { setTab(0); }, 0);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // Muat & terapkan pengaturan
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function applySettings(d) {
        var c = d.company || {}, f = d.finance;
        settingsState.company = c;
        settingsState.finance = f;
        settingsState.lockReason = d.base_lock_reason || null;

        fCompany.setValue(c.company_name || '');
        fLegal.setValue(c.legal_name || '');
        fAddress.setValue(c.address || '');
        fCity.setValue(c.city || '');
        fProvince.setValue(c.province || '');
        fPostal.setValue(c.postal_code || '');
        fCountry.setValue(c.country || '');
        fPhone.setValue(c.phone || '');
        fEmail.setValue(c.email || '');
        fWebsite.setValue(c.website || '');
        fTax.setValue(c.tax_id || '');
        fFooter.setValue(c.doc_footer || '');
        fSignName.setValue(c.doc_signer_name || '');
        fSignTitle.setValue(c.doc_signer_title || '');

        currencyDs.loadData({ data: d.currencies || [] });
        if (f) {
            fBase.setValue(f.base_currency_id);
            fReport.setValue(f.report_currency_id);
            fRateType.setValue(f.default_rate_type);
            fBasisPl.setValue(f.rate_basis_pl);
            fMonth.setValue(f.fiscal_year_start_month);
            fDecimals.setValue(f.amount_decimals);
        } else {
            fBase.clearValue();
            fReport.clearValue();
            fRateType.setValue('KMK');
            fBasisPl.setValue('AVERAGE');
            fMonth.setValue(1);
            fDecimals.setValue(2);
        }

        var locked = !!settingsState.lockReason;
        fBase.setDisabled(locked || !canWrite);
        fLockInfo.setValue(locked
            ? '<div class="set-note set-warn">&#128274; Mata uang dasar terkunci. ' + enc(settingsState.lockReason) +
              ' Mata uang laporan keuangan tetap dapat diubah kapan saja.</div>'
            : (f ? '' : '<div class="set-note set-warn">Pengaturan keuangan belum diatur. Pilih mata uang dasar (umumnya IDR) lalu simpan.</div>'));

        if (!canWrite) {
            [fRateType, fReport, fBasisPl, fMonth, fDecimals].forEach(function (x) { x.setDisabled(true); });
            [fCompany, fLegal, fAddress, fCity, fProvince, fPostal, fCountry, fPhone, fEmail, fWebsite, fTax,
             fFooter, fSignName, fSignTitle].forEach(function (x) { x.setReadOnly(true); });
        }

        showLogo('document');
        showLogo('app');
        updateDocPreview();
    }

    function reloadSettings() {
        ajax({ task: 'load_settings' }, function (res) {
            if (!res.success) { Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Gagal memuat pengaturan.'); return; }
            applySettings(res.data);
        });
    }

    mainBtnDisable('#addData');
    mainBtnDisable('#editData');
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';

    reloadSettings();
});

    }

        url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'list_bin_locations' },

    });

    var itemGridDs = new Ext.data.Store({

            },

                renderer: function (v) {
                    if (v === 'reversed') return '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-weight:bold;">Reversed</span>';
                    return '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Posted</span>';

                if (rec) {

                    // [FIX] Edit tidak lagi dipakai (dokumen posted tidak punya form

                    // Delete di-enable di sini, dipakai untuk aksi Reverse (lihat

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3. Detail View Renderer (Disamakan dengan PO / GRN)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    function loadWhrcvDetail(id, refNo) {
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_edit', id: id },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    whrcvDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat detail.</div>';
                    whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                renderWhrcvDetailView(res.data.items || [], refNo);
            },
            failure: function () {
                whrcvDtlDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:red;">Gagal terhubung ke server.</div>';
                whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    }

    function renderWhrcvDetailView(rows, refNo) {
        var fmtQty = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var fmtAmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); };

        var html = '<h3 class="detail-title">Detail Item WH Rcv: ' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(refNo || '') + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr class="detail-hr" />' +
                   '<table class="detail-table" width="100%" cellSpacing="0" cellPadding="0">' +
                   '<thead>' +
                   '<tr class="header-row">' +
                   '<th align="left">Nama Item</th>' +
                   '<th style="text-align:right;">Qty Diterima</th>' +
                   '<th align="left">Lot No</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Harga Satuan</th>' +
                   '<th align="right">Subtotal</th>' +
                   '</tr>' +
                   '</thead>' +
                   '<tbody>';

        var grandTotal = 0;

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty-msg">Tidak ada item detail.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var qty = parseFloat(r.qty_received) || 0;
                var cost = parseFloat(r.unit_cost) || 0;
                var subtotal = qty * cost;
                grandTotal += subtotal;

                html += '<tr class="data-row">' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.item_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" style="color:#4ade80; font-weight:bold;">' + fmtQty(qty) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="left">' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.lot_no || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right">' + fmtAmt(cost) + '</td>' +
                        '<td align="right" class="subtotal-val">' + fmtAmt(subtotal) + '</td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }

        html += '</tbody>' +
                '<tfoot>' +
                '<tr class="total-row">' +
                '<td colspan="4" align="right" class="total-label">Total Nilai Diterima:</td>' +
                '<td align="right" class="total-val">' + fmtAmt(grandTotal) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>' +
                '</tfoot>' +
                '</table>';

        whrcvDtlDiv.innerHTML = html;
        whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 4. Item Grid Editor (Form Grid)

    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: itemGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },

                renderer: function (v) { return '<b style="color:#2e9e4f;">' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000') + '</b>'; }
            },
            {
                header: 'Lot No', dataIndex: 'lot_no', width: 100,
                editor: new myTextField({})
            },
            {
                header: 'Bin Location', dataIndex: 'bin_location_id', width: 130,
                editor: new myComboField({
                    store: binLocationDs, displayField: 'code', valueField: 'id',
                    mode: 'local', triggerAction: 'all', forceSelection: true
                }),
                renderer: function (v) {
                    if (!v) return '-';
                    var rec = binLocationDs.getById(v);
                    return rec ? rec.get('code') : v;
                }
            },
            {
                header: 'Harga Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_cost', width: 100, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Subtotal', dataIndex: 'qty_input', width: 120, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v, meta, record) {
                    var subtotal = (parseFloat(record.get('qty_input')) || 0) * (parseFloat(record.get('unit_cost')) || 0);
                    return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(subtotal, '0,000.00') + '</b>';
                }
            }
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'qty_input') {
                    var maxQty = parseFloat(e.record.get('qty_remaining')) || 0;
                    var qtyInput = parseFloat(e.value) || 0;
                    if (qtyInput > maxQty) {
                        e.record.set('qty_input', maxQty);
                        Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Qty melebihi sisa GRN. Otomatis dibatasi ke ' + Ext.util.Format.number(maxQty, '0,000.0000') + '.');
                    }
                    if (qtyInput < 0) {
                        e.record.set('qty_input', 0);
                    }
                }
                updateWhrcvTotalLabel();
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    function updateWhrcvTotalLabel() {
        var total = 0;
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0;
            var cost = parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0;
            total += qty * cost;
        });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblWhrcvTotal');
        if (el) el.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00');
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------

    var fldGrnHdr = new myComboField({

        store: warehouseDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false,

    var fldReceivedDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tgl Terima', id: 'received_date', name: 'received_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date() });
    var fldRemark = new myTextArea({ fieldLabel: 'Keterangan', id: 'remark', name: 'remark' });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 130,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },

    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    // 6. Action Handlers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        if (getFormAccess() >= 2) {
            task = 'create';
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            itemGridDs.removeAll();
            grnDs.load();
            updateWhrcvTotalLabel();
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Penerimaan Fisik Gudang Baru';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        // [FIX] Edit dimatikan permanen -- dokumen WH Rcv yang sudah posted
        // tidak punya form edit, cuma bisa dibatalkan lewat tombol Delete
        // (yang menjalankan Reverse, lihat handler di bawah).
        Ext.Msg.alert('Info', 'Dokumen yang sudah posted tidak bisa diedit. Gunakan tombol Delete untuk membatalkan (reverse) transaksi ini.');
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        // [FIX] Aksi "Delete" untuk modul ini sebenarnya adalah Reverse
        // (pembatalan dengan jejak audit tetap ada) -- dokumen WH Rcv yang
        // sudah posted TIDAK di-hard-delete, karena sudah memengaruhi stok
        // dan jurnal. Sebelumnya aksi ini keliru dipasang di tombol Edit.
        if (!dataRecord) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih data WH Rcv yang akan di-reverse.');
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status === 'reversed') {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'WH Rcv ini sudah di-reverse sebelumnya.');
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() >= 4) {
            Ext.Msg.confirm('Konfirmasi Reverse', 'Reverse WH Rcv \'' + dataRecord.ref_no + '\'? Stok & jurnal akan dibatalkan.', function (btn) {
                if (btn === 'yes') {
                    Ext.Ajax.request({
                        url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
                        method: 'POST',
                        params: { task: 'reverse', id: dataRecord.id },
                        success: function (response) {
                            var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                            if (res.success) {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Informasi', res.message || 'WH Rcv berhasil di-reverse.');
                                whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                                mainDs.load();
                                grnDs.load();
                                dataRecord = null;
                                mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');
                            } else {
                                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message);
                            }
                        },
                        failure: function () {
                            Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', 'Gagal menghubungi server.');
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        } else {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Akses Ditolak', 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk reverse.');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var grnHdrId = fldGrnHdr.getValue();
        if (!grnHdrId) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih GRN yang mau diterima terlebih dahulu.');
            return;
        }
        if (!fldWarehouse.getValue()) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Pilih gudang terlebih dahulu.');
            return;
        }

        var arrItems = [];
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            var qty = parseFloat(r.get('qty_input')) || 0;
            if (qty > 0) {
                arrItems.push({
                    grn_dtl_id: r.get('grn_dtl_id'),
                    item_id: r.get('item_id'),
                    item_name: r.get('item_name'),
                    grade_id: r.get('grade_id'),
                    qty_received: qty,
                    unit_cost: parseFloat(r.get('unit_cost')) || 0,
                    lot_no: r.get('lot_no') || null,
                    bin_location_id: r.get('bin_location_id') || null
                });
            }
        });

        if (arrItems.length === 0) {
            Ext.Msg.alert('Peringatan', 'Minimal 1 item dengan qty diterima > 0.');
            return;
        }

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/whrcvCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: 'create',
                grn_hdr_id: grnHdrId,
                warehouse_id: fldWarehouse.getValue(),
                received_date: fldReceivedDate.getValue().format('Y-m-d'),
                items: JSON.stringify(arrItems)
            },
            waitTitle: 'Menyimpan',
            waitMsg: 'Memproses penerimaan & posting stok/jurnal...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Sukses', res.message || ('WH Rcv ' + res.ref_no + ' berhasil disimpan.'));
                whrcvDtlDiv.style.display = 'none';
                mainDs.load();
                grnDs.load();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                Ext.Msg.alert('Gagal', res.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem.');
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('whrcvDtlContainer').style.display = 'none';

});

    function renderKursDetailPanel(rows, kmkNo) {
        var fmtUnit = function(v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000'); };

        var html = '<div class="detail-title">Rincian Nilai Kurs Pajak Mingguan (Terhadap Rupiah / IDR) — KMK No: ' +
                   Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(kmkNo || '') + '</div>' +

                   '</thead>' +

    if (document.getElementById('addWdw')) document.getElementById('addWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

    function loadSummary() {
        summaryGrid.el.mask('Memuat...');

    // 4. Mutation Detail
    function loadMutation() {
        Ext.Ajax.request({

            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_mutation', item_id: currentItemId, warehouse_id: currentWarehouseId },

                    mutationDiv.innerHTML = '<div style="color:yellow;">Gagal memuat mutasi.</div>';
                    mutationDiv.style.display = 'block';
                    return;

                lastMutationRows = res.data || [];
                renderMutationView(res.data);
                setPrintMutationEnabled(true);
            }
        });

    function renderMutationView(rows) {
        var fmt = function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.0000'); };
        var scopeLabel = currentWarehouseId > 0 ? '' : ' (Semua Gudang)';

        var html = '<h3 style="margin-top:0; color:#ffffff !important;">Mutasi Stok: ' + currentItemName + scopeLabel + '</h3>' +
                   '<hr style="border:0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); margin:10px 0 15px;" />' +
                   '<table width="100%" style="border-collapse:collapse; font-size:12.5px;">' +
                   '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);">' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;">Tanggal</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;">Jenis Transaksi</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;">No. Referensi</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;">Gudang</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;" align="right">Masuk</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;" align="right">Keluar</td>' +
                   '<td style="padding:6px; color:#cccccc !important;" align="right">Saldo Berjalan</td>' +
                   '</tr>';

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
            html += '<tr><td colspan="7" style="padding:15px; text-align:center; color:#aaaaaa !important;">Belum ada mutasi.</td></tr>';
        } else {
            Ext.each(rows, function (r) {
                var isIn = r.movement_type === 'IN';
                var masuk = isIn ? fmt(r.qty) : '-';
                var keluar = !isIn ? fmt(r.qty) : '-';
                var refLabel = refLabels[r.reference_type] || r.reference_type;
                html += '<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + r.movement_date + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + refLabel + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + (r.reference_no || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#ffffff !important;">' + (r.warehouse_name || '-') + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#4ade80 !important; font-weight:bold;" align="right">' + masuk + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#f87171 !important; font-weight:bold;" align="right">' + keluar + '</td>' +
                        '<td style="padding:6px; color:#ffffff !important;" align="right"><b>' + fmt(r.running_balance) + '</b></td>' +
                        '</tr>';
            });
        }
        html += '</table>';

        mutationDiv.innerHTML = html;
        mutationDiv.style.display = 'block';
    }

                '</tr></thead><tbody>';

            if (!lastMutationRows.length) {
                bodyHtml += '<tr><td colspan="7" class="empty">Belum ada mutasi.</td></tr>';
            } else {
                Ext.each(lastMutationRows, function (r) {
                    var isIn = r.movement_type === 'IN';
                    var refLabel = refLabels[r.reference_type] || r.reference_type;
                    bodyHtml += '<tr>' +
                        '<td>' + r.movement_date + '</td>' +
                        '<td>' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(refLabel || '') + '</td>' +
                        '<td>' + Ext.util.Format.htmlEncode(r.reference_no || '-') + '</td>' +

                        '<td class="r"><b>' + fmt(r.running_balance) + '</b></td>' +
                        '</tr>';
                });
            }
            bodyHtml += '</tbody></table>';
        }

        var html =
            '<html><head><title>' + title + '</title>' +
            '<style>' +
            '@page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 15mm; }' +
            'body { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color:#000; margin:0; }' +

            '.sub { margin:8px 0; font-size:12px; }' +

            'th { background:#eee; }' +
            '.r { text-align:right; }' +
            '.empty { text-align:center; padding:15px; color:#666; }' +
            '.ftr { margin-top:14px; font-size:10px; color:#555; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; }' +

            '<div class="hdr"><div class="company">' + (window.companyName || 'PT. NAMA PERUSAHAAN') + '</div>' +
            '<h1>' + title + '</h1></div>' +

            '<div class="ftr"><span>Dicetak: ' + printedAt + '</span><span>Halaman <span class="pageNumber"></span></span></div>' +

        if (!win || win.closed || typeof win.closed === 'undefined') {

            return;
        }

        win.document.open();
        win.document.write(html);
        win.document.close();

        // Tidak pakai win.onload -- setelah document.write()+close(), event load

        // jadi print() di dalam onload sering tidak pernah ke-trigger.
        setTimeout(function () {
            win.focus();
            win.print();
        }, 300);

    ];

                    loadTrialBalance();
                }
            }
        }
    });
    periodDs.load();

    var tbDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/trialbalanceCRD.php',

    });

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Filter bar
    // ============================================================
    var fldPeriod = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Periode', width: 200, store: periodDs, displayField: 'period_name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldHideZero = new Ext.form.Checkbox({ boxLabel: 'Sembunyikan saldo nol', checked: true });
    var btnShow = new Ext.Button({ text: 'Tampilkan', cls: 'field-button grey-field-button' });

        ]
    });

    function loadTrialBalance() {
        var perId = fldPeriod.getValue();
        if (!perId) return;

        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/trialbalanceCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'read_trial_balance', period_id: perId },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    summaryDiv.innerHTML = res.message || 'Gagal memuat data.';
                    return;
                }

                var rows = res.data;
                if (fldHideZero.getValue()) {
                    rows = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.debit != 0 || r.credit != 0; });
                }
                var reader = tbDs.reader;
                tbDs.loadData({ data: rows, totalCount: rows.length }, false);

                var balanceColor = res.is_balance ? '#2e9e4f' : '#c0392b';
                var balanceText = res.is_balance ? 'BALANCE ✓' : 'TIDAK BALANCE ✗';
                summaryDiv.style.background = res.is_balance ? 'rgba(255, 0, 255, 0.29)' : 'rgb(255, 255, 0)';

                    ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b>Total Kredit:</b> ' + Ext.util.Format.number(res.total_credit, '0,000.00') +
                    ' &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b style="color:' + balanceColor + ';">' + balanceText + '</b>';
            }
        });
    }

    btnShow.on('click', loadTrialBalance);
    fldHideZero.on('check', loadTrialBalance);

    // ============================================================

    let mainHeight=(maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));

    var gridMain = new stdGridPaging({

            }

    });

document.getElementById('addSaveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
  let phone = Ext.getCmp('cont_phone').getValue();
  let mobile = Ext.getCmp('cont_mobile').getValue();
  let email = Ext.getCmp('cont_email').getValue();

  let cont_contact = (phone == null || phone === '') ? '' : ' Phone : ' + phone;
  cont_contact += (mobile == null || mobile === '') ? '' : '<br> Mobile : ' + mobile;
  cont_contact += (email == null || email === '') ? '' : ' <br> Email : ' + email;

  let formattedAddress = (Ext.getCmp('cont_addr').getValue() || '').replace(/\n/gi, '<br>');

  if (gridEditorCheck === 1) {
    let sm = gridEditor.getSelectionModel();
    let rec = null;

    // Safely retrieve selected record regardless of SelectionModel type
    if (typeof sm.getSelected === 'function') {
      rec = sm.getSelected();
    } else if (typeof sm.getSelections === 'function') {
      rec = sm.getSelections()[0];
    } else if (typeof sm.getSelectedCell === 'function') {
      let cell = sm.getSelectedCell();
      if (cell) {
        rec = gridEditor.getStore().getAt(cell[0]);
      }
    }

    if (rec) {
      rec.set('name', Ext.getCmp('cont_name').getValue());
      rec.set('position', Ext.getCmp('cont_position').getValue());
      rec.set('address', formattedAddress);
      rec.set('contact', cont_contact);
      rec.set('phone', phone);
      rec.set('mobile', mobile);
      rec.set('email', email);
      rec.set('remark', Ext.getCmp('cont_remark').getValue());
      gridEditor.getView().refresh();
    } else {
      Ext.Msg.alert('Warning', 'Please select a row in the contact grid first.');
      return;
    }
  } else {
    gridEditor.store.add(new addRow({
      cont_id          : Ext.getCmp('cont_id').getValue(),
      cont_address_id : Ext.getCmp('cont_address_id').getValue(),
      cont_email_id   : Ext.getCmp('cont_email_id').getValue(),
      cont_mobile_id  : Ext.getCmp('cont_mobile_id').getValue(),
      cont_phone_id   : Ext.getCmp('cont_phone_id').getValue(),
      name            : Ext.getCmp('cont_name').getValue(),
      position        : Ext.getCmp('cont_position').getValue(),
      address         : formattedAddress,
      contact         : cont_contact,
      phone           : phone,
      mobile          : mobile,
      email           : email,
      remark          : Ext.getCmp('cont_remark').getValue()
    }));
  }
  document.getElementById('addWdw').style.display = 'none';
};

Ext.onReady(function() {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();

    if (document.getElementById("mainHeaderText")) {
        document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "User <em>List</em> ";
    }

    var task = '';
    var deleteRow = 0;
    var deleteRecord = null;
    var dataRecord = null;

    // ==========================================
    // 1. EVENT HANDLERS TOP TOOLBAR BUTTONS
    // ==========================================
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function(event) {
        task = '';
        if (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined' && (formAccess == 2 || formAccess == 3 || formAccess == 4)) {
            task = 'create';
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;New User";
            
            var editorFormEl = document.getElementById('editorForm');
            var btnAddItemEl = document.getElementById('btnAddItem');
            if (editorFormEl && btnAddItemEl) {
                var gridEditorHeight = editorFormEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - btnAddItemEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - 5;
                if (Ext.getCmp('gridEditor')) {
                    Ext.getCmp('gridEditor').setHeight(gridEditorHeight);
                }
            }
            
            gridDetailDs.load({ params: { task: 'read_detail', user_id: 0 } });
            gridEditorDs.load({ params: { task: 'read_detail', user_id: 0 } });
            Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().reset();
            Ext.getCmp('name').focus('', 10);
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to access this window';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function(event) {
        task = '';
        if (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined' && (formAccess == 3 || formAccess == 4)) {
            if (!dataRecord || !dataRecord.id) {
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Pilih data user terlebih dahulu dari tabel.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }

            task = 'update';
            Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().load({
                url: '../php-crud/m.user.systemCRD.php',
                params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' },
                success: function(form, action) {
                    // Pastikan hidden field employee_id dan combo name terisi presisi
                    if (dataRecord.employee_id) {
                        Ext.getCmp('employee_id').setValue(dataRecord.employee_id);
                        Ext.getCmp('name').setValue(dataRecord.employee_id);
                    }
                }
            });
            
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("editorFormHeaderText").innerHTML = "&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit User";
            
            var editorFormEl = document.getElementById('editorForm');
            var btnAddItemEl = document.getElementById('btnAddItem');
            if (editorFormEl && btnAddItemEl) {
                var gridEditorHeight = editorFormEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - btnAddItemEl.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - 5;
                if (Ext.getCmp('gridEditor')) {
                    Ext.getCmp('gridEditor').setHeight(gridEditorHeight);
                }
            }
        } else {
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'not enough permission to access this window';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function(event) {
        if (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined' && formAccess == 4) {
            if (!dataRecord || !dataRecord.id) {
                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'Pilih data user yang akan dihapus.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }

            task = 'delete';
            deleteRow = 0; // Pastikan bukan penghapusan baris grid editor
            var userName = dataRecord.employee_name || dataRecord.login_name || '';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = 'delete \'' + userName + '\' ?';
        } else {

        }

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function(event) {
        var arrForm = [];
        
        // Loop data store pada grid editor hak akses menu
        if (Ext.getCmp('gridEditor')) {
            var store = Ext.getCmp('gridEditor').getStore();
            store.each(function(rec) {
                arrForm.push({
                    id: rec.data.id || 0,
                    form_id: rec.data.form_id || 0,
                    access_level: rec.data.access_level || 1
                });
            });
        }

        // Tangkap employee_id dengan proteksi dari ComboBox 'name' atau Hidden Field 'employee_id'
        var selectedEmployeeId = Ext.getCmp('name').getValue() || Ext.getCmp('employee_id').getValue();

        Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().submit({
            method: 'POST',
            params: {
                task: task,
                user_id: (dataRecord && dataRecord.id) ? dataRecord.id : 0,
                employee_id: selectedEmployeeId,
                u_active: Ext.getCmp('AddActive').getValue(),
                form_access: Ext.util.JSON.encode(arrForm)
            },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function(form, action) {
                var objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                var messages = objResponse.message || 'Data berhasil disimpan.';

                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = messages;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';

                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                if (gridDetailDs && dataRecord && dataRecord.id) {
                    gridDetailDs.load({ params: { task: 'read_detail', id: dataRecord.id } });
                }

                Ext.getCmp('frmEditor').getForm().reset();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function(form, action) {
                var messages = 'Gagal menyimpan data ke database.';
                if (action && action.response && action.response.responseText) {
                    var objResponse = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                    messages = objResponse.message || messages;
                }

                document.getElementById("popWdwTxt").innerHTML = messages;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
            return;

        if (task == 'delete') {
            deleteDs.load({
                params: { task: "delete", id: dataRecord.id },
                callback: function(records, operation, success) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    task = '';
                    
                    var messages = 'Data berhasil dihapus.';

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Fiscal <em>Period</em>";

    }

    // ============================================================

    });
    mainDs.load();

        btn.style.display = 'block';
        btn.innerHTML = dataRecord.is_closed
            ? '<t>Reopen</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">lock_open</i>'
            : '<t>Close</t><i class="material-icons md-22 white">lock</i>';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 3. Editor Form (Add periode baru)
    // ============================================================
    var fldName = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'Nama Periode', id: 'period_name', name: 'period_name', allowBlank: false, emptyText: 'ex: 2026-08 atau Agustus 2026' });
    var fldStart = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Mulai', id: 'start_date', name: 'start_date', allowBlank: false });
    var fldEnd = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Selesai', id: 'end_date', name: 'end_date', allowBlank: false });
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 120,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 1, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldName },
            { columnWidth: 0.5, items: fldStart },
            { columnWidth: 0.5, items: fldEnd },
            { items: fldId },
            { columnWidth: 1, items: FieldSpaceTopLabel }

        ]
    });
    frmEditor.on('clientvalidation', function (f, valid) { if (!valid) { saveEditDisable(); } else { saveEditEnable(); } });

    // ============================================================
    // 4. Toolbar
    // ============================================================
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        if (getFormAccess() == 2 || getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Tambah Periode';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    var closeReopenBtn = document.getElementById('closePeriod');
    if (closeReopenBtn) {
        closeReopenBtn.onclick = function () {
            if (!dataRecord) {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih periode terlebih dahulu.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            if (getFormAccess() < 4) {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya akses tertinggi yang boleh menutup/membuka periode.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                return;
            }
            var actionTask = dataRecord.is_closed ? 'reopen' : 'close';
            var confirmMsg = dataRecord.is_closed
                ? 'Buka kembali periode \'' + dataRecord.period_name + '\'?'
                : 'Tutup periode \'' + dataRecord.period_name + '\'? Setelah ditutup, jurnal baru tidak bisa masuk ke periode ini.';

            task = actionTask;
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = confirmMsg;
        };
    }

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.is_closed) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Periode yang sudah ditutup tidak boleh dihapus.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hapus periode \'' + dataRecord.period_name + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus data.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };
  document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function (event) {
        window.open("../pdf/fiscalperiod.php", 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
    };
    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/m.fiscalperiodCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: task },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        if (task == 'delete' || task == 'close' || task == 'reopen') {
            var actionDs = new Ext.data.Store({ url: '../php-crud/m.fiscalperiodCRD.php' });
            actionDs.load({
                params: { task: task, id: dataRecord.id },
                callback: function (records, operation) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(operation.response ? operation.response.responseText : '{}');
                    document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message || 'Selesai';
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    task = '';
                    mainDs.load();
                }
            });
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});


## File: ./invoice.js

/*
  Document      : m.invoice.js
  Description   : Sales Invoice - Header Grid + Editor Form dengan item
                   grid inline-editable. Status draft -> final (final
                   dipicu otomatis oleh tombol Print).
  Backend       : /inv/php-crud/invoiceCRD.php
*/

Ext.onReady(function () {
    Ext.QuickTips.init();
    document.getElementById("mainHeaderText").innerHTML = "Sales <em>Invoice</em>";

    var task = '';
    var dataRecord = null;

    function getFormAccess() {
        return (typeof formAccess !== 'undefined') ? formAccess : (window.formAccess || 0);
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 0. Buat elemen tambahan (Add Line & Total) secara dinamis
    // ============================================================
    (function injectExtraUI() {
        var gridContainer = document.getElementById('editorFormGrid');
        if (gridContainer && !document.getElementById('btnAddItem')) {
            var soItemPanel = document.createElement('div');
            soItemPanel.id = 'soItemPickerPanel';
            soItemPanel.style.cssText = 'padding:6px; margin-bottom:6px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius:4px; display:none;';
            gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(soItemPanel, gridContainer);

            var toolbar = document.createElement('div');
            toolbar.style.padding = '5px 0';
            //toolbar.innerHTML = '<button id="btnAddItem" type="button" class="field-button grey-field-button">+ Tambah Item Manual</button>';
            gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(toolbar, gridContainer);

            var totalsDiv = document.createElement('div');
            totalsDiv.className = 'invoice-totals';
            totalsDiv.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 0; font-weight:bold; font-size:14px; color:#fff;';
            totalsDiv.innerHTML = 'Total: <span id="lblInvoiceTotal">0.00</span>';
            gridContainer.parentNode.insertBefore(totalsDiv, gridContainer.nextSibling);
        }
    })();

    function renderSoItemPicker() {
        var panel = document.getElementById('soItemPickerPanel');
        if (!panel) return;

        if (soItemDs.getCount() === 0) {
            panel.style.display = 'none';
            return;
        }

        // Otomatis masukkan SEMUA item SO yang belum di-invoice ke grid invoice
        soItemDs.each(function (r) {
            var soItemId = r.get('so_item_id');
            var soqty = r.get('qty');
            var sounitprice = r.get('unit_price');
            var sosubtotal = r.get('subtotal');

            var exists = itemGridDs.findExact('so_item_id', soItemId) >= 0;
            if (!exists) {
                itemGridDs.add(new addItemRow({
                    so_item_id: soItemId,
                    description: r.get('description') || r.get('product_name') || '(tanpa deskripsi)',
                    qty: soqty, unit_price: sounitprice, subtotal: sosubtotal
                }));
            }
        });
        updateInvoiceTotal();

        panel.style.display = 'block';
        panel.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:12px; color:#2e9e4f;">✓ ' + soItemDs.getCount() + ' item dari Sales Order ini sudah otomatis ditambahkan ke daftar item invoice di bawah.</div>';
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 1. Field definitions & stores
    // ============================================================
    var invoiceField = [
        { name: 'id' }, { name: 'invoice_no' }, { name: 'so_id' }, { name: 'so_ref_no' },
        { name: 'customer_id' }, { name: 'customer_name' },
        { name: 'invoice_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'due_date', type: 'date', dateFormat: 'Y-m-d' },
        { name: 'total_amount', type: 'float' }, { name: 'paid_amount', type: 'float' }, { name: 'status' }
    ];

    var itemField = [
        { name: 'line_id' }, 
        { name: 'so_item_id' }, 
        { name: 'description' }, 
        { name: 'qty', type: 'float' },
        { name: 'unit_price', type: 'float' }, 
        { name: 'subtotal', type: 'float' }
    ];
    var addItemRow = Ext.data.Record.create(itemField);

    var soItemField = [
        { name: 'so_item_id' }, 
        { name: 'description' },
        { name: 'qty' }, 
        { name: 'unit_price' }, 
        { name: 'subtotal' },  
        { name: 'product_name' }
    ];
    var soItemDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_so_items' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data' }, soItemField)
    });
    soItemDs.on('load', renderSoItemPicker);

    var soField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'ref_no' }, { name: 'tx_date' }, { name: 'legacy_customer_name' }];
    var soDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_so' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, soField)
    });
    soDs.load();

    var customerField = [{ name: 'id' }, { name: 'name' }];
    var customerDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_customer' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', idProperty: 'id' }, customerField)
    });
    customerDs.load();

    var itemGridDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        baseParams: { task: 'read_items' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, itemField)
    });

    // ============================================================
    // 2. Main grid
    // ============================================================
    var mainDs = new Ext.data.Store({
        url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
        idProperty: 'id',
        baseParams: { task: 'read' },
        reader: new Ext.data.JsonReader({ root: 'data', totalProperty: 'totalCount' }, invoiceField)
    });
    mainDs.load();

    function statusRenderer(v) {
        return v === 'final'
            ? '<span style="color:#2e9e4f;font-weight:bold;">Final</span>'
            : '<span style="color:#e08e0b;">Draft</span>';
    }
    let mainHeight=(maxGridHeight(document.getElementById('divMainGrid')));

    var gridMain = new stdGridPaging({
        store: mainDs,
        renderTo: 'divMainGrid',
        height : mainHeight,
        columns: [
            { header: 'No. Invoice', dataIndex: 'invoice_no', width: 110, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'No. SO', dataIndex: 'so_ref_no', width: 100, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Customer', dataIndex: 'customer_name', width: 160, renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Tanggal', dataIndex: 'invoice_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            { header: 'Jatuh Tempo', dataIndex: 'due_date', width: 90, renderer: Ext.util.Format.dateRenderer('d M Y') },
            {
                header: 'Total', dataIndex: 'total_amount', width: 120, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            {
                header: 'Terbayar', dataIndex: 'paid_amount', width: 110, align: 'right',
                renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); }
            },
            { header: 'Status', dataIndex: 'status', width: 80, align: 'center', renderer: statusRenderer }
        ],
        listeners: {
            cellclick: function (grid, rowIndex) {
                dataRecord = grid.getStore().getAt(rowIndex).data;
                mainBtnEnable('#deleteData');
                editDataEnable();
            }
        },
        pageSize: 250,
        pageStore: mainDs
    });
    editDataDisable();
    mainBtnDisable('#deleteData');

    // ============================================================
    // 3. Item grid (inline editable)
    // ============================================================
    var itemDeleter = new Extensive.grid.ItemDeleter();

    var itemGrid = new stdGridEditor({
        store: itemGridDs,
        renderTo: 'editorFormGrid',
        viewConfig: { forceFit: true, scrollOffset: 0 },
        height: 200,
        selModel: itemDeleter,
        columns: [
            { header: 'Deskripsi', dataIndex: 'description', width: 220, editor: new myTextField({}), renderer: CellWrap },
            { header: 'Qty', dataIndex: 'qty', width: 70, align: 'right', editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }), renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); } },
            { header: 'Harga Satuan', dataIndex: 'unit_price', width: 120, align: 'right', editor: new myNumberField({ decimalPrecision: 2 }), renderer: function (v) { return Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00'); } },
            { header: 'Subtotal', dataIndex: 'subtotal', width: 130, align: 'right', renderer: function (v) { return '<b>' + Ext.util.Format.number(v || 0, '0,000.00') + '</b>'; } },
            itemDeleter
        ],
        listeners: {
            afteredit: function (e) {
                if (e.field === 'qty' || e.field === 'unit_price') {
                    var qty = parseFloat(e.record.get('qty')) || 0;
                    var price = parseFloat(e.record.get('unit_price')) || 0;
                    e.record.set('subtotal', qty * price);
                }
                updateInvoiceTotal();
            }
        }
    });
    itemGrid.addClass('x-grid3-gridEditor');

    document.getElementById('btnAddItem') && (document.getElementById('btnAddItem').onclick = function () {
        itemGridDs.add(new addItemRow({ description: '', qty: 1, unit_price: 0, subtotal: 0 }));
    });

    function updateInvoiceTotal() {
        var total = 0;
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) { total += parseFloat(r.get('subtotal')) || 0; });
        var el = document.getElementById('lblInvoiceTotal');
        if (el) el.innerHTML = Ext.util.Format.number(total, '0,000.00');
    }
    itemGridDs.on('update', updateInvoiceTotal);
    itemGridDs.on('add', updateInvoiceTotal);
    itemGridDs.on('remove', updateInvoiceTotal);
    itemGridDs.on('load', updateInvoiceTotal);

    // ============================================================
    // 4. Editor Form
    // ============================================================
    var fldInvoiceNo = new myTextField({ fieldLabel: 'No. Invoice', id: 'invoice_no', name: 'invoice_no', readOnly: true, emptyText: 'Auto-generate' });
    var fldSo = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Sales Order', id: 'so_id', name: 'so_id', hiddenName: 'so_id',
        store: soDs, displayField: 'ref_no', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false,
        listeners: {
            select: function (combo, record) {
                soItemDs.load({ params: { so_id: record.get('id') } });

                // Coba cocokkan Customer berdasarkan NAMA (bukan ID -- SO lama
                // pakai tabel m_customer yang terpisah dari tabel customers
                // baru, ID-nya tidak sebanding).
                var legacyName = (record.get('legacy_customer_name') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                fldCustomer.clearValue();
                if (legacyName) {
                    var matchIdx = customerDs.findBy(function (rec) {
                        return (rec.get('name') || '').trim().toLowerCase() === legacyName;
                    });
                    if (matchIdx >= 0) {
                        fldCustomer.setValue(customerDs.getAt(matchIdx).get('id'));
                    } else {
                        document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Customer SO ("' + record.get('legacy_customer_name') + '") tidak ditemukan otomatis di data Customer baru. Silakan pilih Customer secara manual.';
                        document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });
    var fldCustomer = new myComboField({
        fieldLabel: 'Customer', id: 'customer_id', name: 'customer_id', hiddenName: 'customer_id',
        store: customerDs, displayField: 'name', valueField: 'id', allowBlank: false
    });
    var fldInvDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Tanggal Invoice', id: 'invoice_date', name: 'invoice_date', allowBlank: false, value: new Date() });
    var fldDueDate = new myDateField({ fieldLabel: 'Jatuh Tempo', id: 'due_date', name: 'due_date' });
    var fldId = new myTextField({ name: 'id', id: 'id', hidden: true });

    var frmEditor = new stdForm({
        id: 'frmEditor',
        renderTo: 'editorFormMain',
        labelWidth: 110,
        defaults: { xtype: 'container', layout: 'form', columnWidth: 0.5, baseCls: 'x-plain' },
        items: [
            { items: fldInvoiceNo },
            { items: fldSo },
            { items: fldCustomer },
            { items: fldInvDate },
            { items: fldDueDate },
            { items: fldId }
        ]
    });
    frmEditor.on('clientvalidation', function (f, valid) { if (!valid) { saveEditDisable(); } else { saveEditEnable(); } });

    // ============================================================
    // 5. Toolbar
    // ============================================================
    document.getElementById('addData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        frmEditor.getForm().reset();
        if (getFormAccess() == 2 || getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'create';
            itemGridDs.removeAll();
            soItemDs.removeAll();
            var panel = document.getElementById('soItemPickerPanel');
            if (panel) panel.style.display = 'none';
            updateInvoiceTotal();
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Tambah Invoice';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editData').onclick = function () {
        task = '';
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya invoice berstatus Draft yang boleh diedit.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 3 || getFormAccess() == 4) {
            frmEditor.getForm().reset();
            task = 'update';
            frmEditor.getForm().load({ url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php', params: { id: dataRecord.id, task: 'read_edit' } });
            itemGridDs.load({ params: { id: dataRecord.id } });
            if (dataRecord.so_id) soItemDs.load({ params: { so_id: dataRecord.so_id } });
            document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('editorFormHeaderText').innerHTML = '&nbsp;&nbsp;Edit Invoice';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses ke halaman ini.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('deleteData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih data terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (dataRecord.status !== 'draft') {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hanya invoice berstatus Draft yang boleh dihapus.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        if (getFormAccess() == 4) {
            task = 'delete';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Hapus invoice \'' + dataRecord.invoice_no + '\' ?';
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menghapus data.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
        }
    };

    // Print -- finalisasi otomatis dulu (draft -> final + jurnal), baru buka PDF
    document.getElementById('printData').onclick = function () {
        if (!dataRecord) {
            document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Pilih invoice terlebih dahulu.';
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            return;
        }
        Ext.Ajax.request({
            url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: 'finalize', id: dataRecord.id },
            success: function (response) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(response.responseText);
                if (!res.success) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    return;
                }
                if (!res.already_final) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                }
                window.open('../pdf/invoice.php?id=' + dataRecord.id, 'sub', 'toolbar=no', 'location=no', 'status=no', 'directories=no', 'menubar=no');
            },
            failure: function () {
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = 'Gagal menghubungi server untuk finalisasi invoice.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('saveEdit').onclick = function () {
        var arrItems = [];
        itemGridDs.each(function (r) {
            arrItems.push({
                so_item_id: r.get('so_item_id'),
                description: r.get('description'), qty: r.get('qty'),
                unit_price: r.get('unit_price'), subtotal: r.get('subtotal')
            });
        });

        frmEditor.getForm().submit({
            url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php',
            method: 'POST',
            params: { task: task, arrItems: JSON.stringify(arrItems) },
            waitTitle: 'Connecting',
            waitMsg: 'Sending data...',
            success: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message;
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                mainDs.load({ params: { task: 'read' } });
                frmEditor.getForm().reset();
                itemGridDs.removeAll();
                document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
            },
            failure: function (form, action) {
                var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(action.response.responseText);
                document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message || 'Gagal menyimpan invoice.';
                document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
            }
        });
    };

    document.getElementById('popOK').onclick = function () {
        if (task == 'delete') {
            var deleteDs = new Ext.data.Store({ url: '../php-crud/invoiceCRD.php' });
            deleteDs.load({
                params: { task: 'delete', id: dataRecord.id },
                callback: function (records, operation) {
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
                    document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
                    var res = Ext.util.JSON.decode(operation.response ? operation.response.responseText : '{}');
                    document.getElementById('popWdwTxt').innerHTML = res.message || 'Selesai';
                    document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'block';
                    task = '';
                    mainDs.load();
                }
            });
        } else {
            document.getElementById('popWdw').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('popCancel').style.display = 'none';
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('editorWdw').style.display = 'none';
});

## File: ./m.materials.js
